searchText: Hi every body. Can HD wallet be implemented in Ethereum? (Because of the account-based and non UTXO structure) Yes, and it is. However, it would be somewhat unreasonable to have every transfer move all of your money to a new account like with UTXOs so people usually use HD Wallets but just utilize a few of them for specific purposes. When can we expect EIP-1559 to be released to general public? The pain is real when gas prices are high, it takes +8 hours sometimes to confirm a transaction... It is going live in London, around July. While it won't lower gas prices, it will help you know how much to pay if you don't want to wait 8+ hours 😅 That would be awesome. We're working with NFTs and it's been a real struggle during peak hours. I think on average, we're re-submitting each transactions 3~4 times before it gets through. We've adjusted the preferred gas price from "safe low" to "fast" and it reduces the time window to call the transaction, but it also reduces the "limbo" state Why not just arrange with pools directly or a service like flashbots to get things through fast? Thank you for the tips, I'm actually not sure how to get started with that. Can you point me towards the right direction? > Thank you for the tips, I'm actually not sure how to get started with that.
